fuel_economy_mpg.source: FHWA Highway Statistics 2023 VM-1, combination trucks: 195,758 M vehicle-miles / 29,296,989 thousand gallons

box_fuel_economy_mpg.source: FHWA Highway Statistics 2023 VM-1, single-unit trucks: 134,101 M vehicle-miles / 17,162,839 thousand gallons

van_fuel_economy_mpg.source: FHWA Highway Statistics 2023 VM-1, light duty vehicles, long wheelbase: 705,521 M vehicle-miles / 39,334,720 thousand gallons

light_driver_wage_hourly_usd.source: BLS OEWS 2025, SOC 53-3033 Light Truck Drivers, national mean hourly wage

box_lease_per_day_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer) (a 26' box truck on a full-service lease)

box_insurance_per_day_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer)

box_repair_maintenance_per_mile_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer)

box_tires_per_mile_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer)

van_lease_per_day_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer) (a high-roof cargo van on a lease)

van_insurance_per_day_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer)

van_repair_maintenance_per_mile_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer)

van_tires_per_mile_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a straight truck or a cargo van costs less than a tractor-trailer)

reefer_unit_gallons_per_hour.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a trailer reefer unit running, loaded)

lodging_per_night_usd.source: assumption: about the GSA standard lodging rate; a driver without a sleeper cab resting away from home

driver_wage_hourly_usd.source: BLS OEWS 2025, SOC 53-3032, national mean hourly wage

driver_wage_annual_usd.source: BLS OEWS 2025, SOC 53-3032, national mean annual wage

driver_benefits_load.source: assumption: no public source fetched (benefits as a share on top of wages)

repair_maintenance_per_mile_usd.source: ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking 2024 Update, Table 8 (2023 average per mile)

tires_per_mile_usd.source: ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking 2024 Update, Table 8 (2023 average per mile)

truck_trailer_lease_per_day_usd.source: assumption, in line with ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking 2024 Update, Table 8 (2023 average per mile): truck/trailer payments $0.360/mi at about 100,000 miles a year

insurance_per_day_usd.source: assumption, in line with ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking 2024 Update, Table 8 (2023 average per mile): insurance $0.099/mi at about 100,000 miles a year

company_driver_pay_per_mile_usd.source: ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking 2024 Update, Table 8 (2023 average per mile): driver wages $0.779 + benefits $0.188 per mile (a tractor's company driver is paid by the mile, every mile)

team_pay_factor.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a team truck's pay per mile, split between its two drivers, against one solo driver's)

owner_operator_linehaul_share.source: USA Truck's published owner-operator split, 68% of linehaul (DC Velocity, 2017); fuel surcharge and detention go to the owner in full

owner_operator_carrier_cost_per_day_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (the carrier's trailer and cargo/liability insurance for a leased-on owner-operator)

owner_operator_cost_per_mile_usd.source: ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking 2024 Update, Table 8 (2023 average per mile): an owner-operator's own costs per mile besides fuel (repair, tires, permits, tolls, 75% of truck/trailer payments for the tractor, 50% of insurance); the shares are assumptions

owner_operator_net_floor_per_mile_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (the least an owner-operator clears per mile, after their own costs and fuel, to take a trip)

owner_operator_pay_per_mile_atri_usd.source: ATRI 2024 Update, Table 16 (2023 contracted owner-operator pay per mile): for comparison

overhead_per_unit_per_day_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched: what ATRI's marginal costs leave out (dispatch, the office, safety, IT), set so the re-planner's operating margins land near ATRI's truckload margins (2024 Update, Table 21: 10% in 2021, 8% in 2022, 3% in 2023). The same for every seat and week, so it changes no score

temp_driver_hourly_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (a staffing agency's bill rate for a CDL-A driver)

detention_free_hours.source: assumption: no public source fetched (common contract term)

detention_rate_per_hour_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (paid by the shipper to the carrier)

tonu_fee_usd.source: assumption: no public source fetched (truck ordered, not used)
